title: Apple becomes first company to reach $1 trillion market cap in historic milestone
text: Apple becomes first company to reach $1 trillion market cap in historic milestone Thursday, 2 August 2018 ( 19 minutes ago ) As with other landmarks, the Apple record is significant because of its resonance beyond the financial universe. ▶ How Apple Just Made History 00:44 Getty AAPL Apple 206.58 4.95 (+2.50 %) Disclaimer Get real-time AAPL charts here " Apple is the first publicly-owned company to reach a $1 trillion market capitalization.
